title: heap overflow in statDecodePage free-chain walk; needs DBSTAT_VTAB
live_proof: fuzz-corpus diff: the image reproduces on stock 3.22.0 under host ASan as heap-buffer-overflow in statDecodePage at sqlite3.c:177925
object: the page buffer statDecodePage walks while following the free-block chain
lifetime_ender: not a lifetime defect: a corrupt free-block chain sends the walk past the end of the page
shape: read past the end of the record
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator, with a reconstructed trigger (see case 34). Needs -DSQLITE_ENABLE_DBSTAT_VTAB. Distinct from case 38: the same function, a different walk -- the free-chain traversal rather than the cell-pointer array

spatial.oracle: completes and prints its own marker ('NOTRAP done', rc=0). Recorded as no-marker until 2026-10-05, when the raw log disproved it: the runner had filed it INFRA because the BOOT returned 1 -- the next case in the queue hung -- and charged that to the head of the remaining list. The case's own return code says why nothing was detected: s0_rc=7, SQLITE_NOMEM -- the 256 KB memsys5 arena is exhausted first

sublet.oracle: VM HALTED on a capability fault, cause 24 untagged dereference (temporal: revoked, or never a capability) pc=0x800239e4 -- taken outside the domain, so cooperative recovery has no frame to return through; all 28 halts in this arm are at the same kernel pc 0x800239e4
